name: Fiujlaali-McDonald conjecture: every odd antihole is strongly chromatic-choosable (proved)
result: True for every l >= 3: the only (l-1)-list assignments from which the odd antihole on 2l-1 vertices cannot be coloured are the constant ones; an odd-hole-free k-critical graph of maximum degree D containing an odd antihole of length 2(D-k)+7 is that antihole. Constructions: cutting the cycle into paths, Hall's condition on the lists, and a gluing step.

notes.human: not yet refereed (Journal of Graph Theory package ready)
